summary.whatChanges: Adds an "Open" button next to test annotations of type "traces" in the Vitest UI and HTML report. Clicking it opens a new tab, fetches the trace attachment, and loads it into the hosted Playwright Trace Viewer via postMessage, with pop-up and failure fallbacks. Adds browser fixture and Playwright e2e tests.
behaviorChanges: Annotations with type 'traces' now show an 'Open trace' button in both the editor view and the test report view
Clicking it opens a new tab at https://trace.playwright.dev/next/ and posts the downloaded trace blob to it
If pop-ups are blocked, a browser alert tells the user to allow pop-ups
If fetching the trace fails or the viewer doesn't respond within 10s, the popup shows a 'Failed to Open Playwright Trace' page
A download link still renders alongside the new Open button for trace attachments
risks: Trace contents are sent to the third-party site trace.playwright.dev, an external network dependency and potential data-exposure concern
Hardcoded '/next/' viewer URL and 'ready'/'load' message protocol can break if Playwright changes it
Async fetch happens after window.open, so pop-up blockers or slow networks may leave a blank tab; the 10s timeout is fixed
Errors are swallowed by a bare catch, giving users a generic failure page with no diagnostic detail
